name: Beachstüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Beachstüberl in Tirol**

Welcome to your **Beachstüberl** in the heart of **Tirol**! Here, you can enjoy the cozy atmosphere of a traditional Austrian tavern while soaking up the sun and alpine air. Whether you're craving a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh fruit compote or a cold **Tiroler Bier**, our menu has something for every taste.

After a day of hiking in the **Zillertal** or skiing in the **Arlberg**, unwind with a glass of local **Apfelstrudel** wine or a creamy **Topfenstrudel**. Our terrace offers stunning views of the **Nordkette** and the sparkling waters of the **Inn**.

Come and experience the perfect mix of alpine charm and Mediterranean flair—your **Beachstüberl** awaits in **Tirol**!
